findings.text: The task folder holds only requirements.md and review/diff.patch: no summary of what landed, no smoke-test result ("no page load errors", ask 4), and no pointer to the commit that actually fixed the `'ov-keep'` crash. The crash fix is in `public/live/LiveContent.js:51-52` (array `remove`, already committed in fdf4eb003), not in this diff, so a fresh agent cannot tell ask 1 is met. Add a short result.md.

Ask 3 says "notify the owning agent". `public/live/readme.md` (new "Nothing blanks the page" section) says the owner "follows `public/framework/ai/errors/`" and so hears of each error, but nothing in the diff or task folder shows that subscription exists or was tested. `/live/failures.jsonl` does not exist yet (written on first error), and the readme itself admits `follow` refuses `public/live/`. Either create and verify the follow, or reword the readme to say who is notified today.

Nothing exercises the browser-side boundaries (`LivePage.safely`, `LivePage.Broken`, `LivePage.Errors`, the per-part `part()` wrapper). `LivePage.test.mjs:150-160` only covers `replay_line` and array `remove` in node, so ask 2 ("per card render") is claimed but unproven. Add a screenshot or a test of a card that throws, or record the manual check.
`LivePage.js` `part("header", …)` is used for both Head and Md, so two different failures log the same `where`. Use "subheader" for the Md part.
`LivePage.Errors` registers `page.on("caught", …)` and never removes it. If the view is rebuilt this leaks a listener; it only guards on `el.isConnected`.
`ErrorLog.report` returns null for repeats (`ErrorLog.js:50`), so a line that fails the same way every load logs once. That is probably intended, but say so in the readme.
`ext/ErrorLog/readme.md` does not mention LivePage as a caller, and its `module: "/live/"` failures path. Add one line so the module's readme stays the index of who writes its log.
Part 2 (previews) is untouched, as requirements.md says; it should be filed as its own task so it is not lost.

log.msg:
Result: the ov-keep crash was code, not a bad write: LiveContent.keep took a list of ids as one card (hotfix fdf4eb003 on compliance/dev, pushed). /live/plan/ then blanked on voice-app's {"tab":{…,"title"}} lines (core tab() built a plain Page); LivePage.tab override, same hotfix. This branch: replay_line catch, LivePage.safely/Broken per card and per part, LivePage.Errors, ErrorLog report (740980f0d); tabs stream (dec8e1e74); review notes (320ae167a). Checks: LivePage.test 31 pass; headless worktree /live/item-test/ with a bad line shows the error card and the rest draws; safely() in the browser returns .live-broken and restores View.captor; tab add/remove streams on /live/

/ and /live/

// with no page errors.

answer.reply: fixed: the result line above (commits, the hotfix, every check run).

fixed: mastermind-live-page follows public/framework/ai/errors (list_follows shows it, gather 30 s); ErrorLog writes every caught error there as well as /live/failures.jsonl, which Servex follow refuses (public/live/ is ignored). The failures.jsonl is written on the first error; one was seen at 01:10:27 (voice-app's {"tabs":…} line).

fixed: headless check in the worktree: LivePage.safely(page,'card',()=>{set_captor(); throw}) returned a .live-broken view reading 'Card “bad-card” could not be drawn: card boom', View.captor and its stack depth restored, caught_errors ['card:card boom']. Errors card seen earlier on /live/item-test/ with an injected bad line. A node test cannot draw (no DOM), so these stay browser probes.
fixed: the header text part logs as 'subheader' (320ae167a).
fixed: Errors lets go of its 'caught' listener on the first event after it left the page (320ae167a).
noted: intended; one line per page and message, the error card still counts every repeat.
fixed: ext/ErrorLog/readme.md names LivePage and its /live/failures.jsonl (320ae167a).
noted: previews are part 2 of requirements.md, the next merge from this same task, started right after this one.

complete.outcome: One bad line never blanks a /live/ page: a broken card draws an error box, errors go to failures.jsonl; ov-keep crash fixed; merged
